name: Try2: 200 diverse eighteen-metre missions with test7 stage3

selection.candidate_sampling: Enumerate feasible ordered cell pairs; random bearing within the corner-defined angular span; uniform start inside source/shifted-goal rectangle intersection; goal=start+18m unit bearing
selection.balancing: Fill rarer categories first, then greedy cell coverage and category/cell diversity with seeded random tie breaks; feasible user examples attempted first; repeated cell pairs penalized
selection.geometric_category_rules: Same as try1; multiple_choices has priority when >=5 cells and >=4 terrain types
selection.initial_yaw: Independent uniform [-pi, pi), fixed in mission file
selection.reference_note: Frozen selected-episode snapshot includes tentative E4; later collection edits do not change this panel

path_note: Geometric diversity constraints describe assigned segments, not predicted policy outcomes. All 200 outcomes must be retained.
